caption:
Your jealousy is a weapon. Discipline means converting emotion into fuel. Here's the self improvement mindset shift for success.

Every man feels jealousy. The difference: one feeds resentment until it becomes him. The other feeds hunger instead.

Mind is a creature of habit. Jealousy is just a thought pattern. Break it today. Every burn you feel, convert it. Cold shower. Pushups. Build something.

That emotion is proof you know what you want. The only question is whether you waste it or turn it into your greatest advantage.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
